description: Inserts or updates budget entries (monthly values) of a plan; a value that already exists for the same entry and month is overwritten. Exactly one of category, account or knw_row_number is set per entry. An account entry may name one sub-account as part of the account, e.g. "8400/130" (slash, as shown in the app); there is no separate sub_account parameter. The main account is sub-account 000: "8400" and "8400/000" mean the same and are compared against the actuals of the main account ONLY (not the sum of the sub-accounts; main-account and sub-account entries never overlap). If the account has no main account but exactly ONE sub-account, that one is used; with SEVERAL the entry is rejected (BUDGET_ACCOUNT_AMBIGUOUS, sub-accounts listed). A sub-account that does not exist for the tenant is rejected (BUDGET_ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN). An account unknown to the tenant is still accepted. Amounts are signed (expenses negative); plans created from a file upload that store expenses as positive magnitudes are rejected. For a forecast plan (type=forecast) the entries cover the ACTUAL values of the closed months plus the forecast of the remaining months (see create-budget-plan); without the closed months the year/YTD comparison is wrong. A category name that matches no P&L label is rejected with the list of valid category names and nothing is written.

account.description: DATEV account as shown in the app: 4400 or "4400" (main account) or "8400/130" (account/sub-account, slash); "8400/000" = "8400"

cost_center.description: Optional cost center number the entry belongs to

knw_row_number.description: BAB row number from KNW cost report (e.g. 2190)

period.description: Month as YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. "2025-01"); stored as the first of the month

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

plan_id.description: UUID of the target budget plan

name: upload-budget-entries
